research_questions: RQ1: What is Evidence Sufficient / Insufficient / Boundary?
RQ2: Is Sufficiency just 'evidence exists' or an independent concept?
RQ3: What is the G1-G5 to Sufficiency relationship?
RQ5: Can object-independent Minimum Sufficient Evidence be defined?

three_concept_distinction.evidence_availability: Does the needed information exist? (binary per observation surface)
three_concept_distinction.evidence_sufficiency: Can the Human complete the task with available evidence? (task-relative)
three_concept_distinction.evidence_boundary: Evidence supports a weaker claim but not a stronger claim. (claim-level ceiling)
three_concept_distinction.key_distinction: Availability ≠ Sufficiency ≠ Boundary. Availability is necessary but not sufficient for Sufficiency.

g1_g5_sufficiency_matrix.key_finding: Clean separation: G1-G3=INSUFFICIENT, G4=INDETERMINATE, G5=BOUNDARY, L5=SUFFICIENT. Each gap maps to exactly one sufficiency status.

boundary_mechanisms.weaker_claim: Text and Drawing have spatial/structural association
boundary_mechanisms.stronger_claim: Text IS the semantic caption/label of this Drawing

boundary_mechanisms.weaker_claim: Numeric atoms form an aligned column
boundary_mechanisms.stronger_claim: Column is specifically a row-number column (not a value column)

boundary_mechanisms.weaker_claim: Text pair has period+capital boundary signal
boundary_mechanisms.stronger_claim: Text pair is definitively sentence boundary vs reference continuation
boundary_mechanisms.verdict: CONDITIONAL (might resolve with page_context for some sub-cases)

boundary_mechanisms.weaker_claim: Text pair has period+capital boundary signal
boundary_mechanisms.stronger_claim: 'Le.' is a surname → reference list author→title continuation
boundary_mechanisms.verdict: CONFIRMED (cannot resolve with any current evidence)

L1_structural_existence.description: These two objects have a spatial/geometric relationship

L2_structural_classification.description: This text is structurally associated/separated from this object
L2_structural_classification.supported_by: L5 cases (definitive judgment) + G5 cases (structural claim)

L3_semantic_identity.description: This text IS a caption / label / row-number / author name / reference
L3_semantic_identity.supported_by: NONE — never supported by current evidence → Evidence Boundary

minimum_sufficient_evidence.supported_for_structural_claims: TARGET + REFERENCE + RELATION + CONTEXT (4 function categories, object-independent)
minimum_sufficient_evidence.not_supported_for_semantic_identity: No amount of structural evidence supports semantic identity; requires SEMANTIC FUNCTION not in current evidence surface
minimum_sufficient_evidence.proof: 65 SUFFICIENT cases have all 4 categories; 55 INSUFFICIENT cases are missing at least one (G1-G3)

cross_task_convergence.pattern: All 3 tasks show the SAME boundary mechanism: structural evidence → semantic identity interpretation gap
cross_task_convergence.task_1_text_drawing: structural association → semantic caption identity (9+4 boundary cases)
cross_task_convergence.task_2_text_text: structural column membership → semantic column type (2+4 boundary cases)
cross_task_convergence.task_3_graphic: structural figure-text proximity → semantic tick label identity (0 boundary — insufficient cases dominate)
cross_task_convergence.conclusion: The boundary is ALWAYS at L2→L3 transition. Not task-specific, not object-specific.

task_2.cases: 26 KEEP resolved + 18 ABSTAIN (G2) + 1 FP (G4) + 2 BOUNDARY + 4 CONDITIONAL

stop_criteria_check.STOP_2_subjective_boundary: PARTIAL (claim levels are researcher-induced but grounded in cases)
stop_criteria_check.conclusion: No stop criteria triggered. Research can conclude.

Q1_availability_vs_sufficiency_distinct.proof: 55 cases have available evidence but are insufficient (G1-G3); 13 have available but boundary (G5); only 65 have available AND sufficient (L5)

Q2_minimum_sufficient_evidence_identifia.supported: For structural claims: TARGET+REFERENCE+RELATION+CONTEXT (65 SUFFICIENT cases prove this pattern)
Q2_minimum_sufficient_evidence_identifia.not_supported: For semantic identity claims: no amount of structural evidence is sufficient (13 BOUNDARY cases prove the ceiling)

Q3_evidence_boundary_exists.proof: 13 cases pass all B1-B6 criteria; 9 CONFIRMED (C3=NO) + 4 CONDITIONAL (C3=PARTIAL). Boundary is real and stable.

Q4_boundary_distinguishable_from_G1G5.proof: G1-G3=INSUFFICIENT (not boundary), G4=INDETERMINATE (not boundary), G5=BOUNDARY. Clean separation: 0 G1-G4 cases are boundary, 0 G5 cases are non-boundary. Evidence Boundary = G5.

Q5_cross_task_convergence.proof: All 3 tasks show same boundary mechanism: structural evidence → semantic identity gap. Stable across 13 documents, 8 types, multiple problem types.
